PRECISION AND EXPERIENCE

By working alongside Italy’s most famous bike fitter Michele Dalla Piazza on many occasions, Matteo had a chance to learn from the best and apply the learning with the knowledge of the sport in his 25 years cycling experience.

As a performance obsessed person, I am very meticulous about the little details in bike fitting, I work on every millimeter and I believe that the smallest adjustments are the one that make the difference, both for comfort and performance.

By working alongside Michele, I have learned a lot and my approach is the same. No fancy tools or software. Just precision and experience by seeing each person’s pedal stroke, flexibility, bone construction, muscle mass and knowing their cycling and injury history.

Software is a great tool for bike fitting, but they only give a good range to work with, it is then the experience of the bike fitter to make the best possible fit.

Matteo Cigala, Founder & Head Coach

Bike fitting in Wicklow, Ireland

BIKE FITTING

A precise, hands-on bike fit with Head Coach Matteo Cigala: more comfort, more power, fewer niggles. €80 / £70 per bike.

Make your reservationWhatsApp usPrices ↓
Learned from the best

PRECISION AND EXPERIENCE

By working alongside Italy’s most famous bike fitter Michele Dalla Piazza on many occasions, Matteo had a chance to learn from the best and apply the learning with the knowledge of the sport in his 25 years cycling experience.

As a performance obsessed person, I am very meticulous about the little details in bike fitting, I work on every millimeter and I believe that the smallest adjustments are the one that make the difference, both for comfort and performance.

By working alongside Michele, I have learned a lot and my approach is the same. No fancy tools or software. Just precision and experience by seeing each person’s pedal stroke, flexibility, bone construction, muscle mass and knowing their cycling and injury history.

Software is a great tool for bike fitting, but they only give a good range to work with, it is then the experience of the bike fitter to make the best possible fit.

Matteo Cigala, Founder & Head Coach
What we look at

EVERY MILLIMETRE COUNTS

  • Saddle height & setback

    Set from how you pedal, not only from a formula.

  • Reach & handlebar
